reviews.text: My skin is very sensitive and I don't use any retinol or harsh anti aging creams because of this reason and I've never had a problem with this cream. I use it at night under the eyes, forehead and along the smile expression lines on my cheeks and I have noticed they've smoothed out a bit. It also doesn't feel irritating in the slightest and has no smell.
reviews.zh: 我嘅皮膚好敏感，所以我唔會用任何視黃醇或者強效抗老霜，我用呢款面霜從來都冇問題。我晚上喺眼下、額頭同面頰上嘅笑紋處用，我留意到佢哋都順滑咗少少。佢亦完全唔會刺激，而且冇味道。

reviews.text: I really like the MIXSOON Bean Eye Cream! It has a lightweight, creamy texture that feels really comfortable around my eyes and doesn’t feel heavy or sticky. It keeps the under-eye area feeling soft and moisturized, and I like how easily it fits into my skincare routine. A little goes a long way, so I don’t need to use much each time. Overall, it’s a nice eye cream for everyday use, especially if you prefer something gentle and hydrating.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意 MIXSOON Bean Eye Cream！佢質地輕盈、綿密，塗喺眼周好舒服，唔會覺得厚重或黏膩。令眼下皮膚保持柔軟同滋潤，我好鍾意佢幾容易就可以融入我嘅護膚程序。只需要用少少，所以每次唔使用好多。整體嚟講，係一款日常好用嘅眼霜，特別係如果你鍾意温和、補水嘅產品。

reviews.text: I love the Mixsoon Bean Eye Cream and I really liked how lightweight and soothing it feels around the eye area. The texture is smooth, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave any sticky or heavy residue, which makes it comfortable for both morning and night use. After using it consistently, I noticed my under-eye area felt more hydrated and slightly plumper, giving a fresher and less tired appearance. It’s very gentle and didn’t cause any irritation, even on sensitive skin. Overall, I think it’s a nice simple eye cream for hydration and maintaining a healthy under-eye look without being too heavy or complicated.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意 Mixsoon Bean Eye Cream，我真係好鍾意佢嘅輕盈同舒緩感覺，塗喺眼周好舒服。質地順滑，吸收快，唔會留低任何黏或厚嘅殘留，所以早晚都舒服。持續用咗之後，我覺得眼下嘅皮膚更加水潤、微微飽滿，令我睇起嚟更清新、冇咁攰。佢好温和，即使係敏感皮膚都冇引起任何刺激。總括嚟講，我覺得係一款簡單但有效嘅眼霜，有助保持眼下水潤同健康，唔會太厚重或者複雜。

reviews.text: I’ve been using this product for a while and really like it. It’s gentle, lightweight, and doesn’t irritate my skin. It keeps my skin hydrated without feeling greasy and hasn’t caused any breakouts. Overall, a simple but effective product I’d definitely recommend.
reviews.zh: 我用呢款產品一段時間，好鍾意。佢温和、輕盈，唔會刺激我嘅皮膚。佢令我皮膚保持水潤，又唔會油膩，亦都冇令我爆痘。總括嚟講，係一款簡單但有效嘅產品，我一定會推薦。

reviews.text: Sleek, gentle, and surprisingly effective, this e Beauty product feels like a quiet upgrade to my routine. It’s easy to use, well made, and delivers visible results without irritation. My skin looks fresher, smoother, and more awake after every use.
reviews.zh: 呢款 e Beauty 產品，溫和、簡約，效果出奇地好，為我嘅護膚步驟帶嚟一個安靜嘅升級。用起嚟容易，做工精緻，又可以睇到效果，唔會刺激。每次用完，我嘅皮膚都睇起嚟更清新、更順滑、更有精神。

reviews.text:
i have been using this once a day for a few weeks now and my dark circles are unfortunately still there hahha
it’s a bit less prominent at least? i will continue using it for now and hope there is a bit of improvement and not just placebo xD
reviews.zh:
我而家每日用一次，已經用咗幾個禮拜，可惜我嘅黑眼圈仲係咁，哈哈
至少少少冇咁明顯？我會繼續用吓，希望會有少少改善，唔係淨係安慰劑效應 xD

reviews.text: first use and i’m already amazed by this eye cream. i have fine lines, wrinkles, dark circles and everything, my under eyes tend to be very dry, but after one use i feel my under eye being so much hydrated ? so soft and smooth ? i think tins perfect before makeup, and it will for sure give good results !
reviews.zh: 第一次用已經令我對呢款眼霜驚艷。我有幼紋、皺紋、黑眼圈，樣樣都有，我眼下好容易非常乾，但係用咗一次之後，我覺得眼下嘅水分好多、好軟、好滑？我覺得佢好適合用喺化妝前，一定會有好效果！

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
